gui.jaymoskingdoms.formation.title: Formation
gui.jaymoskingdoms.formation.0.desc: Shoulder to shoulder, shields to the front and bows behind. They turn to face the foe.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.formation.1.desc: A point behind you, the best at the tip.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.formation.2.desc: A ring of shields around you, facing out.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.formation.3.desc: Two by two behind you, for the road.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.formation.4.desc: The formation marches to the spot under your crosshair and holds it.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.formation.5.desc: The formation stays where it stands.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.formation.6.desc: The formation moves with you again.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.formation.7.desc: Every blade at the nearest foes; the bows keep shooting.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.formation.8.desc: Look at someone: the formation goes for them.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.formation.9.desc: They fall out and simply follow you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.formation.no_mark: Nobody there to set them on
speech.jaymoskingdoms.rank.soldier.1: A real shield at last. For %s.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.rank.knight.1: I'll not shame the arms of %s.
